lines.raw: 3/4 pound Brussels sprouts* (ends trimmed and halved (see note))
lines.buy: 2 lb 10 oz Brussels sprouts, ends trimmed and halved
3 1/2 medium yellow onions, thinly sliced (about 5 1/4 cups)

lines.raw: 1 medium tart apple* (such as Granny Smith, halved, cored, and cut into 8 wedges*)
lines.buy: 3 1/2 medium tart apples such as Granny Smith, halved, cored, and cut into 8 wedges each
7 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, divided

lines.raw: 2 1/2 to 3 pounds bone-in skin-on chicken thighs (about 5 thighs)
lines.buy: 8 3/4 lb bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs (about 17 large thighs)
lines.notes: Range line: 2 1/2 lb taken as source basis, about 227 g per thigh across 5 thighs. This is the as-purchased bone-in weight, which is also what the cost lane needs.

lines.raw: 5 sprigs fresh rosemary (plus additional chopped fresh rosemary for serving)
lines.buy: 18 sprigs fresh rosemary, plus chopped fresh rosemary for serving
lines.notes: About 3 g per sprig. Not optional despite the extraction flag - step 3 lays a sprig on every thigh.

rulings.raw: 2 1/2 to 3 pounds bone-in skin-on chicken thighs (about 5 thighs)
rulings.evidence: Bone-in skin-on is its own cut and its own price - refused the bridge to Boneless Skinless Chicken Thigh (a different per-lb price and a different gram weight for the same piece) and to Rotisserie Chicken. chicken-thighs is live at 7 of 7 stores, so the id is a REUSE; only the vocabulary row is new, named with the bone/skin basis in it per the naming rulings.

rulings.raw: 5 sprigs fresh rosemary (plus additional chopped fresh rosemary for serving)
rulings.evidence: Fresh sprigs, not dried-rosemary: a sprig has no dried equivalent and the price class differs. fresh-rosemary is live at 5 of 7 stores and the DB already carries the row.

macro_cross_check.note: Recipe totals 2711 cal / 176 g protein at source scale. Band check on our numbers: 678 cal (under the 700 ceiling by 22), 19.7 carbs, 44.1 protein - all in. The lower bound of the stated 2 1/2 to 3 lb range is what produces this agreement; 3 lb would read 781 cal/serving and push the dish out of band on calories.
